content: We report experiments on the RotoWire benchmark BIBREF10 which contains around $5K$ statistical tables of NBA basketball games paired with human-written descriptions. Our model is compared to several state-of-the-art models. Results show that the proposed architecture outperforms previous models on BLEU score and is generally better on qualitative metrics.
